title: Invalid-session SendRRData negative with complete CPF request
purpose: Isolate session-handle validation on a complete SendRRData frame so the parser sees a well-formed encapsulation and CPF layout while the session handle itself is invalid.

messages.label: SendRRData with invalid session handle and complete CPF/CIP payload

expected_behavior: Server should reject the request with an encapsulation status such as invalid session handle or otherwise terminate processing cleanly before any unsafe CPF/CIP use.
constraints_preserved: SendRRData command 0x006F with complete payload length
Nonzero invalid session handle used intentionally to target session validation
CPF remains well formed with Null Address Item and Unconnected Data Item
CIP request remains bounded and complete enough for parser entry if session validation is deferred
issue_safety_notes: The negative condition is limited to the session handle. The CPF and inner request are kept complete to avoid conflating malformed-body behavior with the intended session-validation path.
